results.description: Widnes Vikings Shop at DCBL Stadium has applied for a licence to sell alcohol for off-premises consumption.

results.title: Can Stephanie White handle the WNBA’s 'hardest job'?
results.description: Around the league, there’s a label that keeps following Stephanie White, and it isn’t about wins or losses. Peers like Phoenix Mercury head coach Nate Tibbetts have called the Indiana Fever head coach job the toughest in professional sports — not because of the roster or the schedule, but because of everything that surrounds it.

results.title: Mitchell Starc’s 10-Wicket haul: Joins Shane Warne and Nathan Lyon in elite Australian Test list
results.description: Mitchell Starc claimed 10 wickets as Australia thrashed Bangladesh by an innings and 51 runs in the second Test in Mackay to level the series 1-1. The haul took Starc to four 10-wicket Test hauls and 771 international wickets as he closed in on the all-time top 10.

results.title: NFL analyst sees plenty of potential in Titans’ top rookies from the 2026 NFL Draft, but nothing is set in stone just yet
results.description: Esteemed NFL analyst Greg Cosell recently discussed a few Titans rookies and there’s a lot to like about what he had to say. The Tennessee Titans are days away from finalizing their roster, and the first preseason game offered a meaningful look at several key rookies.
